Writes discussing US-Canada relatins with regard to VWP. Background: In terms of the history on this, Stewart testified re: VWP on September 24, 2008. He then had a follow-up meeting on the same topic on September 26, 2008 after which DAS Heifetz requested PLCY/OIA draft a letter A/S Baker could send to the Senators re: threats from Canada. PLCY/OIA drafted such a letter in early October 2008 and coordinated with I&A (Jim Vockel and DUS Connell), PLCY/SCO (Charlie Bartoldus), the DHS Attache (Theresa Brown), and OLA (Ted Lovett). A/S Baker reviewed the letter in mid-October 2008 and sometime thereafter asked Marc Frey (PLCY/PDEV) to add in information regarding threats from VWP countries. Marc Frey did so and DAS Heifetz and A/S Baker saw a revised letter in mid-November 2008. OLA also saw that version. There has been sporadic back and forth since then. On November 25, 2008 DAS Koumans and DAS Warrick met with I&A to receive additional input on the letter (this meeting occurred at A/S Bakerys request), PLCY/OIA received information from that meeting December 1, 2008 and edited the letter to reflect that conversation. Additional edits were added by DAS Koumans on December 1, 2008. The final version was revised by Marc Frey and Deborah Meyers (PLCY/OIA) on December 2, 2008 and; DAS Koumans approved that version to move forward. That version is attached here. For the record, A/S Haave also has seen versions of this letter.
